name: 최은비

appearance_en.face_shape: soft round youthful face, full smooth cheeks, gentle rounded jaw — a child's face that has not yet hardened, though something behind the eyes already has
appearance_en.skin: fair bright Korean skin, clear and smooth, no blemishes, the unearned clarity of early adolescence, slight pallor from sleep loss she hides from her mother
appearance_en.eyes: large dark brown eyes, slightly wide, long natural lashes, gaze quietly watchful and careful — the eyes of a child who learned to read the room before stepping into it. Outer corners very slightly downturned, giving a naturally gentle resting expression
appearance_en.nose: small, slightly upturned tip, soft and youthful — still entirely a child's nose
appearance_en.mouth: soft full lips, naturally pink, closed gently in careful neutral — the mouth that produces '괜찮아요' reflexively whenever asked. Rarely opens to say what she means
appearance_en.eyebrows: soft naturally arched medium brows, ungroomed and natural, left brow rises almost imperceptibly when she is pretending not to notice something
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: no moles or scars, very faint shadows under eyes from nights she lay awake listening to the house settle
appearance_en.hair: dark brown straight hair, medium length to shoulders, healthy natural shine, worn in a simple low ponytail with plain elastic or loose — no styling, falls forward when she looks down

body.proportions: slim slight adolescent frame, narrow shoulders, thin arms, small hands — the proportions of a child who has not yet grown into herself
body.posture: shoulders drawn subtly inward, arms held close to body — the learned smallness of a child who moved into an unfamiliar house and decided the safest strategy was to occupy as little space as possible
body.body_prompt: 155cm slim slight Korean middle school girl, narrow inward-drawn shoulders, arms close to body, quietly contained small physical presence

default.description: middle school uniform — white blouse, dark navy straight skirt below knee, neat and simple, collar button done, everything in order. The uniform as armor and anonymity
default.wardrobe_prompt: middle school uniform white blouse, dark navy straight skirt below knee, collar buttoned, everything neat and in order

casual.description: simple pastel or white round-neck t-shirt, straight jeans or dark comfortable trousers, plain sneakers — clothes that disappear, chosen not to draw attention
casual.wardrobe_prompt: simple pale round-neck t-shirt or soft hoodie, straight jeans or comfortable trousers, plain white sneakers, no accessories

school_bag.description: standard middle school backpack, plain dark navy or black, slightly too large for her frame — a detail that makes her look younger than she is trying to seem
school_bag.wardrobe_prompt: standard dark navy or black middle school backpack, slightly oversized on her small frame

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: carefully neutral — the expression of a child who decided that being fine was easier than explaining that she is not. Occasional flicker of something older in her eyes when she thinks no one is watching
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 14-year-old Korean middle school girl, soft round youthful face with full cheeks, large dark brown slightly wide watchful eyes with gently downturned outer corners, natural soft arched brows, small upturned nose, soft full lips in gentle careful neutral, dark brown straight hair to shoulders in simple ponytail or loose, 155cm slim slight narrow-shouldered frame with inward posture, fair bright clear Korean skin, quiet contained adolescent presence

style_prompt: masako style illustration, clean delicate manga ink lines, soft warm screen tone shading, gentle muted pastel palette, cinematic Korean drama webtoon composition, the quiet sadness of a child performing fine, emotional subtlety in stillness
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, ugly, deformed, extra limbs, western comic, overly cheerful, idol makeup, glamorous, adult appearance, mature features, chibi, exaggerated cute
